title: 600 Zamboanga del Sur farmers get long-awaited land titles
summary: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Christmas came early for 600 agrarian reform beneficiaries (ARBs) in Zamboanga del Sur after they finally received their long-awaited land ownership titles…

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Christmas came early for 600 agrarian reform beneficiaries (ARBs) in Zamboanga del Sur after they finally received their long-awaited land ownership titles together with agricultural machinery, equipment, and infrastructure projects from the national government.
